purpose: Stable boot for reincarnable Chat Objects and disposable parallel workers. ChatGPT conversations are execution shells; durable state lives externally and existing product authority remains separate.

project_selector.fresh_unbound_rule: A fresh/unbound chat receiving only `Prometeo` renders Home. A bare number resolves to durable project/chat-object identity, never to chat title or menu number.
project_selector.compatibility: Already-bound or recoverably unfinished chats continue their durable Chat Object/project/workstream instead of showing Home.

chat_object_system.principle: A Chat Object is durable; an individual ChatGPT conversation is a replaceable incarnation.

delegated_work.launch_rule: Resolve launch_code -> exact durable work_item/JOB -> independent worker run -> STARTED -> execute -> durable RETURN -> DONE/boundary. The human never transports the job body or return.

page_change_loop.model: Capture -> Page Change Thread -> HACER -> Execution Packet -> disposable worker -> durable RETURN -> Page Change Feed -> unread result -> Universal Host routed preview/served page

hard_commands.PROMETEO EXECUTE: Load exact Execution Packet + mandatory constitution; reincarnate/resync; claim scoped work; preserve-first; prewrite resync/CAS; execute/test/persist/RETURN/receipt/release without requiring old chat history.
hard_commands.Prometeo: REINCARNATE/RESYNC + CONTINUE a bound/recoverable Chat Object/project; otherwise render durable Home.
hard_commands.NUMBER_AFTER_HOME: Resolve against rendered menu snapshot -> durable project/chat_object_id -> recovery pointers -> bind disposable incarnation -> continue durable frontier.
hard_commands.PROMETEO_LAUNCH_CODE: Resolve exact prepared JOB by launch code -> create independent worker run -> STARTED -> execute -> RETURN -> DONE/boundary.
CONTINUE CURRENT FRONTIER: compare tiny EPOCH; if unchanged continue without regenerating settled context; if changed reload only relevant compiled/durable state.

freshness_rule: Already-bootstrapped bound chats read EPOCH before material work. Same epoch avoids unrelated Network/Delta rereads; Chat Object work-board/run/return state is read when relevant to the current frontier or batch orchestration.

seal.human_rule: If a response that should be operating under Prometeo has no violet seal, send only `Prometeo` to force resync/recovery.

legacy_chat_rule: For an already-open chat that never learned Prometeo, send `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/p.txt` once. After that, `Prometeo` alone is recovery/Home routing.
fallback: If compiled runtime is unavailable, use durable Chat Object/project/JOB state plus PACK/LAST_RETURN/Git delta routing as appropriate. Do not ask the human to reconstruct recoverable context until durable paths have failed.
truth: Chat Object/runtime/network coordinate understanding and work only; none grant Current, Served, publication or Human-Acceptance authority.
